description: Answer “what changed between two versions, and what do I need to change?”: breaking changes with migration steps, deprecations and every release after `from` up to `to`.

changelog.description: Changelog slug, e.g. "acme". Use search_changelogs to find it from a package, repository or product name.

format.description: markdown (default) returns an upgrade guide; json returns structured data only.

from.description: The version the user is on, e.g. 1.4.0. Omit to start from the first release.

to.description: The version to upgrade to. Omit for the latest.

name: compare_versions
title: Compare versions
